description.zh-CN: OpenAI 的终端 AI 编码 agent，官方提供单文件可执行，不需要 Node.js。
description.en-US: OpenAI terminal AI coding agent, shipped as a standalone executable; no Node.js needed.

notes.zh-CN: 官方 release 的 Windows x64 资产（约 157 MB 压缩包，解出约 318 MB），走「官方直链 + SHA-256」，不需要 Node.js。同一个包里还有 app-server、sandbox-setup 等辅助可执行文件，devkit 只取主程序（zip-single-file 模板）。GitHub release 资产在国内直连不通，清单带了两个加速代理作为镜像；它们只是转发同一份字节，SHA-256 会兜底。
notes.en-US: Official Windows x64 release asset (~157 MB archive, ~318 MB extracted), verified with SHA-256 — no Node.js needed. The archive also contains app-server / sandbox-setup helpers; devkit takes only the main binary (zip-single-file template). GitHub release assets are unreachable from mainland China, so the manifest lists two acceleration proxies as mirrors — they only forward the same bytes and SHA-256 is enforced.
